messages:
Maya (product): Quick sync — we need a crisp list of non-negotiable items for GA tomorrow: SLA targets & rollback policy, billing/pricing copy, oncall/runbooks, monitoring/alerting, docs & SDK examples, dedicated capacity packaging. Who owns what? Can we get signoff by EOD? @Ryan @Jamie @Anna @Marcus
Ryan (eng): I can take SLA + rollback wording. Need final SLO numbers and fallback model variants. Also confirm p95/p99 latency budgets per tier.
Jamie (SRE): Oncall + runbooks here. I need the canary rollback playbook and error budget definitions. Also want a staging smoke alert set before GA.
Anna (docs): Docs owner — will prepare API examples, migration notes, and 'what changes at GA' section. Need model version table and deprecation window.
Marcus (sales): Pricing/commits question — are we shipping reserved capacity tiers for GA or soft launch only? Need clear enterprise add-on language.
DevEx Bot: SDK release checklist: update changelog, bump semver, publish packages, update quickstart in docs. Blocking: sample for resumed streaming API.
Maya (product): Short answers: SLA tiers = Free/Standard/Enterprise. Reserved capacity = Enterprise only at GA (will communicate as beta). Billing copy: Marcus please draft. Owners: Ryan(SLA), Jamie(Oncall/alerts), Anna(docs), DevEx(SDK), Marcus(pricing). Can everyone ack?
Ryan (eng): Ack. Proposed SLOs: Standard p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 700ms; Enterprise p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 400ms. Fallback: degrade to smaller model variant + 'service degraded' header.
Jamie (SRE): Ack. Alerts: burn rate alert at 25% of error budget/day, high p99 latency spike alert (thresholds per SLO). Runbook items: rollback, switch routing to fallback variant, notify oncall.
Anna (docs): Ack. I'll open PR for GA docs, include sample request/responses, streaming example, and migration notes. Target PR by 17:00 PT.
Marcus (sales): Ack. I'll draft pricing copy and commit tiers. Question: should we include an SLA rebate table? Might be legal-heavy — propose 'credits up to X%'.
Maya (product): Legal to sign off on rebate wording later — fine as placeholder. Main acceptance criteria for GA: 1) SLOs documented and tests passing in canary, 2) runbooks + oncall assigned, 3) docs PR merged or at least with reviewer signoff, 4) pricing page draft, 5) SDK published to npm/pypi with examples.
ops-bot: checklist update: SLA_doc: in_progress, Runbook: ready_for_review, Docs_PR: open (link), SDK_release: pending
Ryan (eng): Quick snippet I'll add to SLA doc:
```
SLOs:
 - Standard: p95 <= 200ms, p99 <= 700ms
 - Enterprise: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 400ms
Fallback behavior: route to quantized-variant-v1 when latency > threshold, include X-Service-Degraded header
```
Jamie (SRE): I'll create the canary smoke CI job by 16:00 PT. Need hook from runtime for X-Service-Degraded header — @Ryan can you confirm runtime adds header on fallback?
Ryan (eng): Yes runtime will add header. I'll put a flag 'x-service-degraded: true' when variant selection downgraded.
Anna (docs): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/542 — includes examples and migration. Please review.
Marcus (sales): Draft pricing doc uploaded to drive: https://drive.google.com/xxx — comments welcome.
Maya (product): Final ask: please add one-line acceptance in your area and close loop here once done. We reconvene 17:15 PT for final sign-off. :thumbsup:
Ryan (eng): One-line acceptance: SLA doc + runtime flag implemented and canary passes.
Jamie (SRE): One-liner: runbook deployed, oncall rota assigned, canary smoke job green.
Anna (docs): One-liner: PR open with examples and reviewer requested.
Marcus (sales): One-liner: pricing draft ready for legal review.
DevEx Bot: SDK publish scheduled at 16:30 PT — will post status in #devex
Maya (product): Thanks team. If any blockers, ping me. Going to collate for the GA checklist doc.
